BiblicalUsage: Naked is used for the body uncovered, and for the soul laid bare, and the Bible is frank about both. Adam and his wife were both naked and were not ashamed, Job says naked came I out of my mother's womb and naked shall I return, and Isaiah says true fasting is to cover the naked when you see him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe nakedness in Scripture runs from innocence to judgment: unashamed in Eden, stripped by suffering in Job, and clothed again by the mercy of God's people. And I hold that the gospel meets us naked, with nothing of our own to cover us, and clothes us in Christ.
